propositions: Disposition-closed children (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) with live replacement links are exempt from completion-verifier attestation in the close path but treated as uncertified in the certification path, creating an impossible state with no non-dishonest exit.

child_closure_findings requires a valid completion-verifier attestation on every closed direct child regardless of disposition class, while transition_close grants disposition classes an exemption from minting that attestation.
A disposition-closed child cannot earn a completion-verifier attestation by reopening and re-closing because it takes the same exemption branch every time, producing identical unsigned outcomes.

The certification and close paths use different predicates to identify disposition closes, allowing them to drift and create maintenance hazards where new disposition classes would silently acquire the same gap.

The fix mints a deterministic completion-verifier attestation for disposition closes with a live replacement link, recording the disposition class and replacement ID rather than claiming a verification that never occurred.
